name: Patagonia Environmental Grants: Hong Kong and Macau
summary: Small grants, partly in kind, for grassroots non-profits and fiscally sponsored groups running action-oriented environmental projects in Hong Kong and Macau, including conservation and restoration. Research without an action plan, trail work and land acquisition are excluded.

amount.note: An average range; grants are monetary and non-monetary

status.quote: We accept one proposal per group in this fiscal year (1st April 2026 - 31st March 2027).

applicant_types.quote: organizations without a non-profit status or a comparable fiscal sponsor

geography.quote: takes place within Hong Kong and Macau

access.quote: We accept one proposal per group in this fiscal year (1st April 2026 - 31st March 2027).

amount.quote: ranging from an average of HK$30,000 to HK$80,000

window.quote: All grant proposals that are successfully submitted are reviewed within 1 month.
